name: Father James
source:
A priest in service to the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. His influence in the Church of the Divine and among nobles, far exceeds his low clerical status. It is rumoured, James and the [url=https://vndb.org/c165583]Queen[/url] were lovers.
